## Luma (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
LE Small aberration (psionic)  
**Init** +4 **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 19, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +1 natural, +4 shield, +1 size)  
**hp** 62 (7d8+6)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +6, **Will** +6  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** two +5 talons (1d6-1 slashing, 19-20/x2)  
**Ranged** +13 penetrating question (2d6 energy plus question, Will DC negates, 30 ft.)  
**Psionic Powers** (ML 5th; the luma can manifest powers as a 5th-level psion.  

3rd—mindhunter, forced share pain (Will DC 18)  
2nd—compelling voice (Will DC 17), ego whip, (Will DC 17), inflict pain (Will DC 17), read thoughts (Will DC 17)  
1st—demoralize (Will DC 16), empathic connection (Will DC 16), force screen, judge, sense link  
Talents—detect psionics, distract, empathy, far hand, telepathic lash (DC 15 where applicable)  

**Power Point Reserve** 37 pp  

*force screen is included in AC above  


**Statistics**


**Str** 8, **Dex** 19, **Con** 11, **Int** 21, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 17 (19 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Body Fuel, Deep Focus, Psionic Body, Skill Focus (Sense Motive)  
**Skills** Autohypnosis +11, Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Knowledge (local, nobility, psionics) +15, Intimidate +14, Sense Motive +13, Stealth +14  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Orc, telepathy 100 ft.  


**Special Abilities**


**Penetrating Question (Su)** A luma can compel its victims to reveal deeply painful, intensely personal secrets merely by asking in a tone of mind-voice that cannot be denied. These questions are always designed to disturb the victim, or erode the trust and respect of any allies who hear the question (and response).
